The Daily Green

The Daily Green is at 719 Seventh Avenue in Midtown, a block north of Times Square near 48th Street, with about 530 products from 63 brands. It is a vape and edible shop with no loose flower listed at last check: vapes (175), pre-rolls (163) and edibles (153) make up nearly the whole menu, with 25 concentrates and a few tinctures and topicals.

The vape wall is the draw. MFNY (42), STIIIZY (38) and Heavy Hitters (36) are the three deepest brands, with Off Hours, Sluggers and PAX behind them, so this is a good Midtown stop for comparing all-in-ones and cartridges. The entry price is $6 for LayUp drinks in Black Cherry Lemonade, Limeade and Lemonade. For flower near Times Square, Qube at 39th and Broadway carries nearly 400 options.

The Daily Green FAQ
Does The Daily Green sell flower?

Not at last check. The menu is vapes, pre-rolls, edibles and concentrates. If you want loose flower in Midtown, Qube on Broadway at 39th Street has about 390 listings and is a short walk south.

What is it best for?

Vapes. With 175 vape listings and deep MFNY, STIIIZY and Heavy Hitters lines, it is one of the better Midtown spots for cartridges and disposables, and PAX pods are stocked too.

Where is the nearest subway?

The 49th Street N, R, W station and the 50th Street 1 train are each about a block away, and Times Square-42nd Street is a few minutes' walk south.
